title: OpenRubrics: Towards Scalable Synthetic Rubric Generation for Reward Modeling and LLM Alignment
authors_zh: Tianci Liu, Ran Xu, Tony Yu, Ilgee Hong, Carl Yang, Tuo Zhao, Haoyu Wang
paper_type_zh: rubric 生成、偏好数据与奖励模型论文
best_for_zh: 需要构造可解释成对奖励信号，或审计 rubric 是否忠实反映偏好的研究者。
one_line: An open release of generated rubrics and preference data for rubric-conditioned reward modeling.
用对比偏好生成并验证 rubric，把隐式偏好转为可训练的显式奖励依据。
why: It provides an auditable judgment-required feedback surface for post-training reasoning data and evaluation.
inclusion_reason: Track 07 addition: the central contribution creates, calibrates, or audits rubric-, expert-, or LLM-judgment data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Scalar and pairwise reward labels conceal why one answer is preferred. Rubrics make evaluation criteria inspectable, but expert-written rubrics are expensive and directly prompting a frontier model gives uneven quality and cost.

OpenRubrics supplies synthetic, preference-grounded rubrics and trains a rubric generator plus a rubric-conditioned reward model. The goal is scalable reward feedback that preserves explicit instruction constraints as well as higher-level response qualities.

标量分数或成对偏好标签只告诉奖励模型谁更好，却隐藏原因。rubric 能把评价条件显式化，但专家撰写成本高；直接让前沿模型生成又会带来质量不稳和 API 成本。这使奖励信号难以同时覆盖用户明确约束与答案中隐含的高质量特征。

OpenRubrics 构造以偏好为依据的合成 rubric，并训练 rubric 生成器和条件化奖励模型，目标是在可扩展前提下保留可审计的显式指令要求与更高层的回答质量标准。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: OpenRubrics is a 35.7K-instruction collection of prompt-rubric and rubric-conditioned preference records. Contrastive Rubric Generation (CRG) compares chosen and rejected responses to produce two complementary criteria: hard rules for explicit requirements and principles for implicit qualities. A generated rubric survives only if it helps recover the known preference label, turning preference consistency into the acceptance gate. The public Hugging Face release provides datasets and model weights. This changes reward modeling from a direct opaque comparison into a two-stage decision: formulate criteria from the prompt, then judge a response pair against them.

OpenRubrics 包含 35.7K 个指令的 prompt-rubric 记录和带 rubric 的偏好记录。对比式 rubric 生成（CRG）比较 chosen/rejected 回答，产出两类互补条件：描述显式要求的硬规则与描述隐含质量的原则。生成的 rubric 只有在帮助恢复已知偏好标签时才保留，偏好一致性因此成为接受门槛。论文公开 Hugging Face 数据集和模型权重。它把不透明的直接比较改成两步：先由 prompt 形成评价准则，再据准则判别回答对。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Assemble preferences. The authors combine UltraFeedback, Magpie, Skywork-Preference, Synthetic-IF, MegaScience, and Medical-o1. Existing chosen/rejected pairs are reused; for some science and medical data, open models generate candidates and reward-model ensembles form best-worst pairs.
  1. Generate criteria. Given a prompt, ranked responses, and preference signals, an instruction-tuned LLM produces hard rules and principles through CRG.
  1. Filter by agreement. The same model judges induced response pairs with the rubric. The rubric passes only when group accuracy is at least 0.5 and each retained pair receives the known preference label.
  1. Train and infer. A generator is SFT-trained to emit a rubric from a prompt; RUBRIC-RM is SFT-trained to predict A-versus-B using prompt, pair, rubric, and label. At inference it generates or reuses a cached rubric before judging.

Reproduction needs source-data revisions, generation prompts and model, threshold 0.5, training splits, Qwen3 backbone/checkpoints, and benchmark scripts. License terms must be checked at the public release.

1. 汇集偏好数据。 作者组合 UltraFeedback、Magpie、Skywork-Preference、Synthetic-IF、MegaScience、Medical-o1；已有 chosen/rejected 直接复用，部分科学与医疗题由开源模型生成候选、奖励模型集成形成优劣对。
  1. 生成准则。 指令模型读取 prompt、排序回答和偏好信号，经 CRG 生成硬规则与原则。
  1. 以一致性过滤。 同一模型拿 rubric 判别诱导出的回答对；只有组内准确率至少为 0.5，且单个对的判决等于已知标签，rubric 与该样本才保留。
  1. 训练与推理。 生成器经 SFT 从 prompt 输出 rubric；RUBRIC-RM 经 SFT 用 prompt、回答对、rubric、标签预测 A/B。推理时先生成或复用缓存 rubric，再判决。

复现需固定源数据版本、提示词与模型、0.5 阈值、切分、Qwen3 checkpoint、基准脚本；公开发布页许可须另行核验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. Preference-consistent synthetic rubrics yield stronger, smaller reward models than direct judging or comparable white-box baselines.

Controlled evidence. On ten reward and instruction-following metrics, Table 1 compares Qwen3-4B/8B RUBRIC-RM with 7B white-box judges, a direct Qwen-3-8B rubric-plus-judge pipeline, and reference API/14B systems. RUBRIC-RM-8B averages 70.1, versus 57.7 for direct Qwen-3-8B; voting@5 reaches 73.0. On HealthBench, the 8B model scores 68.3 and voting@5 72.9, while direct prompting scores 51.8 (Figure 5).

The comparison supports the configured data construction and two-stage model, but it does not isolate every contribution of source mixture, filtering, model capacity, or voting; online RLHF remains untested.

主张。 与偏好一致的合成 rubric 能让较小奖励模型优于直接裁判和同规模白盒基线。

受控证据。 表 1 在十个奖励与指令跟随指标上比较 Qwen3-4B/8B 的 RUBRIC-RM、7B 白盒裁判、直接 Qwen-3-8B rubric+judge 流程，以及 API/14B 参考系统。RUBRIC-RM-8B 平均为 70.1，直接 Qwen-3-8B 为 57.7；voting@5 达 73.0。HealthBench 上，8B 模型为 68.3、voting@5 为 72.9，直接提示仅 51.8（图 5）。

这支持该数据构造和两阶段模型，但没有逐一隔离源数据混合、过滤、容量与投票的作用；在线 RLHF 尚未测试。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier rubrics-as-rewards work either relies on experts or asks a frontier model to write criteria on demand, so its criteria need not explain known preferences. OpenRubrics changes the construction decision: it conditions rubric synthesis on contrasting ranked responses, separates hard rules from principles, then retains only rubric-pair records that reproduce preference labels. Training a generator and judge on those retained records is not itself a new reward objective; the novelty is the preference-grounded, consistency-filtered rubric data contract.
既有 rubric-as-rewards 要么依赖专家，要么临时请求前沿模型写准则，因此准则未必解释已知偏好。OpenRubrics 改变的是构造决策：它让 rubric 合成条件化于有优劣对比的回答，分出硬规则和原则，再只保留能复现偏好标签的 rubric-回答对。用保留记录训练生成器和裁判并不是新的奖励目标；真正新意是以偏好为依据、经一致性过滤的 rubric 数据契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The authors note that contrastive preference data can transmit model and dataset bias, especially for subjective or culturally specific criteria. Audit rubric disagreement and subgroup behavior before treating it as human preference.
  • The model is formulated for pairwise comparison. Absolute scoring and ranking more than two responses are unverified, so do not use pairwise accuracy as evidence for those settings.
  • The reported optimization is primarily offline preference optimization. Test online-RL stability, reward hacking, and the license/provenance of every constituent source before deployment.

• 作者指出，对比偏好数据会传递模型与数据集偏差，尤其在主观或文化相关准则上；使用前应审计 rubric 分歧和子群体行为，不能直接当作人类偏好。
  • 模型只针对成对比较；绝对评分和多于两个回答的排序尚未验证，不能用 pairwise accuracy 外推。
  • 报告主要验证离线偏好优化。部署前须测试在线 RL 稳定性、奖励投机，以及每个源数据的许可与来源。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a team with prompt-response preferences but no explanation of the decision, apply CRG to generate hard rules and principles, then retain only records whose rubric-conditioned judgment recovers held-out labels. The inputs are licensed preference pairs, a capable rubric generator, and a validation split; the output is auditable pairwise reward data and a judge. Success is label agreement and target-benchmark improvement against a same-backbone direct judge. Do not use it when labels are unreliable or the task needs calibrated absolute scores; first measure label quality and rubric failure modes.
若你有 prompt-回答偏好却没有判决解释，可用 CRG 生成硬规则和原则，再只保留 rubric 条件下能恢复留出标签的记录。输入是有许可的偏好对、可用的 rubric 生成器和验证切分；输出是可审计的成对奖励数据与裁判。成功标准是标签一致性及相对同 backbone 直接裁判的目标基准提升。标签不可靠或任务需要校准绝对分数时不应直接使用；先测标签质量和 rubric 失效模式。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position. OpenRubrics makes preference judging explainable through generated hard rules and principles.
  2. Method handle. CRG sees a prompt plus ranked answers; preference-label consistency at threshold 0.5 decides whether each rubric record survives.
  3. Artifact handle. The release reports 35.7K instructions and publishes data and weights at Hugging Face OpenRubrics; inspect its current license and source subsets.
  4. Evidence anchor. RUBRIC-RM-8B averages 70.1 versus 57.7 for direct Qwen-3-8B; voting@5 reaches 73.0.
  5. Reuse decision. Best for pairwise reward modeling with trusted labels; first audit cultural bias, label noise, and whether an absolute score rather than a pairwise verdict is required.

1. 一句话定位。 OpenRubrics 用生成的硬规则与原则，使偏好判决可解释。
  2. 方法抓手。 CRG 输入 prompt 和排序回答；阈值为 0.5 的偏好一致性决定每条 rubric 记录是否保留。
  3. 数据抓手。 论文报告 35.7K 个指令，并在 Hugging Face OpenRubrics 发布数据和权重；仍须核对当前许可和源数据子集。
  4. 证据锚点。 RUBRIC-RM-8B 平均为 70.1，直接 Qwen-3-8B 为 57.7；voting@5 达 73.0。
  5. 复用决定。 适合标签可信的成对奖励建模；先审计文化偏差、标签噪声，以及任务是否需要绝对分数而非成对判决。
